title: DAEE Typed State Capsule (daee-state-capsule-v1)
description: Per-call typed state capsule contract for Slice D wave 1 (Plan 03). A capsule is the small, structured hand-off that lets a single model call receive kernel + capsule + selected shards instead of replaying a full 150-300KB output.md or a 300k-token runtime. This schema pins the STRUCTURAL shape of one capsule instance only (required + allowed-optional top-level keys and their inner shapes); cross-capsule replay invariants (monotonic offsets, append-only ledgers, artifact parity, provenance-of-generated-burdens) are enforced by tools/check_state_capsule.py, not by this schema. This is not a semantic-faithfulness, interlocutor-uptake, or release-provenance claim. live_registers accepts both the plain ASCII register names (N, m, tau, sigma, heart, xi, Omega, mu, kappa, H) and their Unicode glyph aliases (τ, σ, ♥, ξ, Ω, μ, κ) per tools/register_axis_contract.py's REGISTER_AXIS_ALIASES; both forms are legitimate live-register spellings and neither is mojibake. body_ref and other burden-token fields legitimately carry Unicode superscript burden forms (e.g. ¹B) alongside the bare ASCII form (e.g. B1); both are in scope and are not encoding drift.

case_id.description: Stable identifier for the case/run this capsule sequence belongs to; constant across a replay sequence.

input_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of normalized D0 input, prefixed sha256:; constant across a replay sequence.

stage.description: Current pipeline stage; STAGE ORDER 01..08 must be non-decreasing across a replay sequence.

live_registers.description: Subset of the live-register set. Both plain-name (N,m,tau,sigma,heart,xi,Omega,mu,kappa,H) and Unicode glyph alias forms (τ=tau, σ=sigma, ♥=heart, ξ=xi, Ω=Omega, μ=mu, κ=kappa) are accepted; see tools/register_axis_contract.py REGISTER_AXIS_ALIASES for the canonical alias table.

register_state.description: Current value/annotation per live register; keys are register names/aliases, values are register-specific state payloads.

B_LA.description: Layer-A burden ledger, order-preserving, no duplicates. Anti-slimming: across a replay sequence this list never shrinks.

B_MRP.description: MRP-generated burden ledger, order-preserving, no duplicates. Append-only across a replay sequence; every entry must carry MRP provenance (see tools/check_state_capsule.py).

B_total.description: Order-preserving union of B_LA and B_MRP, no duplicates.

current_burden.description: Burden token currently under traversal, or null when none is active (e.g. terminal capsule).

body_ref.description: Bare join key only (e.g. B1_1 or the Unicode superscript-prefixed form, superscript digits 0-9); must not carry owner/operation pollution such as '[' or '.'.

completed_acts.description: Append-only across a replay sequence; earlier entries preserved verbatim.

terminal_states.description: Map of burden token -> terminal-state label (e.g. Land, rejected, merged) for burdens that have reached closure.

coverage_complete.description: True only when held_set_H is empty AND every burden in B_total is present in terminal_states with a closed state (e.g. Land, rejected, merged).

next_required_action.description: Required non-empty when coverage_complete is false and the capsule is in a PARTIAL/hold_partial state; may be empty string only for fully covered/terminal capsules. Capped at 400 chars to prevent prose-smuggling of law/runtime content into a field meant to be a short imperative.

output_artifact_path.description: Path to the retained output.md artifact this capsule sequence writes into, or null for chat-transport capsules with no retained artifact yet.

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the artifact bytes at output_offset_bytes; required (non-null) whenever output_artifact_path is set.

output_offset_bytes.description: Byte length of the retained artifact as of this capsule; monotonic non-decreasing across a replay sequence.

notes.description: Free-text annotation; capped at 1200 chars to prevent prose-smuggling of law/runtime content past the capsule's small-hand-off size discipline.
